question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The incorrectly spelt word is: **Irresistable**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Irresistable"** is incorrectly spelt.
 
• The correct spelling is** "Irresistible".**
 
• **"Irresistible"** means too attractive or tempting to be resisted. (अप्रतिरोध्य)
 
 
• **Example:** The offer was so irresistible that she immediately accepted it.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Parallel **(समानांतर): Extending in the same direction, equidistant at all points, and never converging or diverging.

 
 
• **Example:** The two roads run parallel to each other for several miles.
 
 
 
• **Recommend **(सिफारिश करना): To suggest that someone or something would be good or suitable for a particular job or purpose.
 
 
• **Example:** I highly recommend this book for anyone who loves mystery novels.
 
 
 
• **Tomorrow** (कल): The day after today.
 
 
• **Example:** We will meet again tomorrow to discuss the project.
